A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

content.text: I'll start by listing the tables and their schemas.
Next I'll compare per-service span volume, error share and latency between the normal and abnormal periods.

input.query: SELECT 'normal' p, service_name, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,2) avg_ms, round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,2) p95_ms, sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) errs FROM normal_traces GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'abnormal', service_name, count(*), round(avg(duration)/1e6,2), round(quantile_cont(duration,0.95)/1e6,2), sum(CASE WHEN attr_status_code='Error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM abnormal_traces GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2,1

content.text: Two services stand out: `ts-route-plan-service` and `ts-travel-plan-service` have latency jumping from tens of ms to over a second. Several services also have fewer spans or are missing. Next I'll break down the travel-plan path by pod and by the operations it calls.

input.query: SELECT 'abn' p, service_name, attr_k8s_pod_name pod, span_name, attr_span_kind kind, count(*) n, round(avg(duration)/1e6,1) avg_ms, sum(CASE WHEN attr_http_response_status_code>=400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) http_err FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name IN ('ts-travel-plan-service','ts-route-plan-service','ts-travel-service','ts-ui-dashboard') GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'norm', service_name, attr_k8s_pod_name, span_name, attr_span_kind, count(*), round(avg(duration)/1e6,1), sum(CASE WHEN attr_http_response_status_code>=400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name IN ('ts-travel-plan-service','ts-route-plan-service','ts-travel-service','ts-ui-dashboard') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 2,4,1
